module.name: Pentavox
module.tagline: 3 Plaits voices + 2 samplers, FX chain with stutter/tape/reverb/granular/phaser

pageHelp: Set brightness, clock PPQ/ratio, Plaits voice mode, sampler choke and record threshold.
Set live Input Level, each slot's SD library file (zone 0 loads nothing) and the final Output Level.
Set quantize, input aux and Clock Loop record length; Chebyshev and Folder are plain red knobs because Settings has no shift layer.

fields.name: Brightness
fields.help: Global LED brightness control in safe ranges. Uses more power.

actions.label: Next voice page
actions.help: Steps voice pages; from FX returns to the last voice page.

actions.label: Shift layer
actions.help: While held: Plaits Attack and Aux send; all sampler shifts; Live Chance/Resonance/Hold/Size; Granular Scatter/Spread/Reverse; Tone Center/CV amount.

actions.label: Next engine / file
actions.help: Plaits: next engine. Sampler: next file of the slot's SD library (B1-hold + B2: next slot), start when armed, or stop recording.

actions.label: Next bank / Arm
actions.help: Plaits: next bank. Sampler: arm or disarm recording.

actions.label: Stutter (FX Live)
actions.help: Momentary stutter while held, on the clock grid. FX Live only.

actions.label: FX pages
actions.help: Enters FX Live; on FX pages steps Live, Granular, Tone.

actions.label: Bypass
actions.help: Release without knob movement to toggle bypass; FX tails freeze.

actions.label: Record knob motion

manual.preamble: Three Plaits voices and two samplers share six knobs and stutter, tape, filter, drive, phaser, granular and reverb FX.

sections.title: Pages and buttons
sections.body: **B1** cycles Plaits 1-3 and Sampler 1-2, returning from FX to the last voice. **B3** enters FX Live, then cycles Live/Granular/Tone. Hold **B1** for shift and **B2+B3** for Settings. After changing pages, catch each knob's stored value.

sections.title: FX Live
sections.body: Pots 0-5: Stutter Time (B1: Chance), Filter (centre bypass; B1: Resonance), Tape Speed, Tape Dry/Wet, Stutter Trigger (B1: Hold), Reverb Mix (B1: Size). Hold **B2** to stutter. Tape is 1x at 12 o'clock, stopped at quarter travel, and reverses toward the far left.

sections.title: MIDI and clock
sections.body: Each voice's MIDI channel is set in CV routing > Notes; Omni accepts every channel. Poly/Unison pool matching Plaits channels, while samplers remain independent. J3-J8 functions are assigned in Studio; by default only J8 is used, as the clock input.

sections.title: Knob record
sections.body: Hold **B3** and move a knob: the motion is recorded and loops after release.

sections.title: Sampler recording
sections.body: On a sampler page hold **B2** to arm. The take starts at the Settings Record Threshold, on the first clock (MIDI clock, MIDI Start or CV clock) when it is set to Clock, on MIDI Start or a reset pulse when it is set to Start or Reset, or with a **B2** tap; Reset+Stop ends on the next reset. Clock Loop waits for a clocked downbeat established by J7 Reset/MIDI Start and records the Settings Record Length (1-16 bars; a slot holds 30 s, so 16 bars need 128 BPM or more). Tap from any page to stop. Both samplers share four slots.

sections.title: SD library
sections.body: Settings > Input & Library selects each slot's WAV: zone 0 loads nothing; later zones pick scanned files. On a sampler page a B2 tap steps to the next file. New takes stay in SDRAM and write to SD when available.

presets.help: Preset slots store the complete state of the module — every page, every setting marked as preset material, and everything else the firmware manages. Slot 0 is the boot slot: it loads automatically at power-up. Presets are saved and named from the web programmer, or from the panel using the module's preset gestures. Slots written by a different firmware version are flagged in the programmer and can be migrated with **Back up all**.
